title: COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based user simulation can support interface design, accessibility research, and interactive-agent evaluation, but standard computer-use agents are optimized for task completion rather than reproducing how people perceive, reason, and act. We introduce COGENT (COGnitive agENT), a modular cognitive architecture for simulating user interaction with desktop interfaces. COGENT draws on established cognitive theories, such as Norman's action cycle and ACT-R, to enable explainable, intervenable, and modular user simulation by decomposing the simulation process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection. We begin by presenting six intervenability demonstrations, each tracing how a single edit to memory, a user attribute, or a processing module propagates through the cognitive pipeline to produce a behavioral change. translated_title: COGENT：用于智能体用户模拟的模块化认知架构
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的用户模拟可以支持界面设计、无障碍研究和交互式智能体评估，但标准的计算机使用智能体是为任务完成而优化的，而非重现人们如何感知、推理和行动。我们提出了COGENT（COGnitive agENT），一个用于模拟用户与桌面界面交互的模块化认知架构。COGENT借鉴了成熟的认知理论，如Norman的动作循环和ACT-R，通过将模拟过程分解为具有感知、记忆、用户状态、意图和行动选择显式表示的认知模块，实现可解释、可干预和模块化的用户模拟。我们首先展示了六个可干预性演示，每个演示追踪了对记忆、用户属性或处理模块的单次编辑如何通过认知管线传播并产生行为变化。我们评估了COGENT的行为与归因……
tldr: COGENT是一个借鉴Norman动作循环和ACT-R等认知理论的模块化认知架构，通过将用户模拟分解为具有显式表示的感知、记忆、用户状态、意图和行动选择等认知模块，实现了对桌面界面交互的可解释、可干预的用户模拟。
en_tdlr: COGENT is a modular cognitive architecture grounded in established cognitive theories (Norman's action cycle and ACT-R) that enables explainable and intervenable simulation of user interaction with desktop interfaces by decomposing the process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection.
